description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the MH-Z19B CO2 sensor, including command definitions, UART communication, configuration, and sensor API implementation.

methods.name: mhz19b_uart_flush
methods.description: Flush UART buffer by reading all available data.

methods.name: mhz19b_send_cmd
methods.description: Send command over UART, optionally wait for response.

methods.name: mhz19b_send_config
methods.description: Send configuration command and verify response.

methods.name: mhz19b_poll_data
methods.description: Poll sensor data for specific command.

methods.name: mhz19b_attr_abc_cfg
methods.description: Enable or disable ABC (Automatic Baseline Correction).

methods.name: mhz19b_attr_set
methods.description: Set sensor attributes like range and ABC.

methods.name: mhz19b_attr_get
methods.description: Get sensor attributes like range and ABC.

methods.name: mhz19b_uart_isr
methods.description: UART interrupt service routine handling RX and TX.

methods.name: mhz19b_init
methods.description: Initialize the sensor device, configure default range and ABC.
